name: Silent Half
source:
Main character regains consciousness at the hospital. His last memories are about a girl that got into an accident together with him.
Time passes, and one day that finally arrives. Protagonist wants to hug and kiss her, but she does not remember him. What will he do?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
